item.title: Timeline: How a noncitizen suspected killer was caught and released by a Newsom-appointed judge
item.description: Surveillance video allegedly shows Marcos Iriarte-Valdez in a tactical vest stabbing retiree Todd Stewart in a quiet East Bay suburb of California.

item.title: Rep. Patronis to Newsmax: Florida's New Residents Fuel GOP Gains
item.description: Rep. Jimmy Patronis, R-Fla., told Newsmax that Florida's influx of new residents is reinforcing the state's Republican advantage rather than shifting its politics.

White House: Tariff Dodgers Cost $26 Billion
item.description: A new White House report says countries are routing exports through third countries to avoid U.S. tariffs, costing an estimated $26 billion.
